ask_description.a.body: Ask the user one to four multiple-choice questions during a task. Use it to gather preferences or requirements, to clarify an ambiguous instruction, to get a decision on an implementation choice, or to offer the user choices of direction. The user can always pick Other and type their own text, so do not add an Other option yourself. Set multiSelect to true when the choices are not mutually exclusive. To recommend an option, make it the first option and end its label with " (Recommended)". Use preview on an option only for a concrete artifact that the user must compare side by side, such as a code snippet, a mockup, or a diagram; a preview works only when multiSelect is false. Each question text must be unique, and each option label must be unique within its question. When you need the user's answer to continue, use this tool, not your reply text. A question in your reply text does not show the user that you are waiting. The call ends your turn until the user answers; the result holds the answer to each question.
